p.i: iam, sede in medio nostrum, & renuncia nobis, &c. Luc.c.2.46.Et factum est triduo post, ut invenerunt eum in templo sedentem in medio Doctorum & audientem eos & interrogantem, vid. Joh. Guil. Stuckiu, lib.2.conuiuial. antiquit. c.35. in fin. varias diversorum populorum opiniones & mores de loco supremo, medio & infimo referentem, & Iustum Lipf. Antiq. lection.lib.3. & Cal. Rhodigin. lib.10. c.15. Pet.Greg. lib.4.de Repub. c.10.num.12.13.

main_text.p: Locus vero a dexteris adsignatus, vel occupatus, dignitatis & honoris esse dicitur. Matth.c. 20.21.& seqq.c.25.33.34. Luc.c.22.20. Coloss cap 3. 1. Marc.c.16.19. 1. Reg. c.2.19. Et sedens in ssolio suo (Salomo) apponi iussit solium matri Regis, quae sedit ad dexteram eius. & Psalm.45.10. & Psalm.110.1. vbi Iunius. Genes. c.48.13.14.17.18. Alex.ab Alex. lib.2.Genial. dier.c.19. Gell.lib.2.c.2. Tiraquellus de iur.primogen.in praefat.num.13.& seqq. Petr. Greg. de Repub.lib.4.c.10.num.10.12. & seqq.libr.6. Syntagm.c.6.7.8.& seqq. vel sessio prope digniorem. Chassan.consid.12 par.1.2.Esd.c.3.

Sedenti praestantiori & honoratiori adstare, honoris & reverentiae argumentum esse dicitur. Genes.c.18.8. Et ipse (Abraham) adstabat eis sub arbore illa comedentibus. Exod.c.18.13 Fuit autem alterodie, sedente Mose ad iudicandum populum, cum adstaret populus ipse Mosi, a mane illius diei usque ad vesperam.& 1.Reg.c.1.28.c.8.14. Tota congregatione Israelis stante, Rex benedixit,&c & verf. 55.1.Sam.c.22.6.9.Genes.c.47.31. c.49.33. vbi Iunius notat.& ad idem allegat Num.c.23.22.Iudic.c. 3.20.2.Reg. c.23.2. 2.Chronic.c.34.31. Nehem.c.8. 6.Iacob.c.2.3.4.Luc.c.22.25,26.Iob c.29.8.9.2.Reg. c.23.

page.notes: Marginal mark: a small degree-like sign beside the line "Locus vero..." at the left edge; left as a reference mark, no note text printed. Some words in the first paragraph are faint; readings of "Stuckiu", "Iustum" and "Tiraquellus" are uncertain.
